decision: Pursue clip-preserving recovery before gripper release; retire the universal passive-latch dependency, preserve the measured retention failure, and require physical coupling plus strong-baseline evidence before learning.
goal: Recover from a failed connector insertion without releasing an earlier cable clip or violating the declared load/time budgets.
question: On unfamiliar cable layouts and mechanical combinations, when does a learned action-outcome selector improve clip-preserving recovery over competent scripted rules and a cable-aware planner at matched experience?

objects.cyan: Single deforming cable, distal end free

what_the_screenshot_shows.task: About22mm of local insertion; no prior clip or post. The fixed-world port is an idealized fixture even though a support board is not visible.
what_the_screenshot_shows.controllers: Left uses observed target alignment and force feedback; right continues on its original axis. Both scripted.
what_the_screenshot_shows.at_2_4s: Both images are pre-completion. The right plug has contacted the fixture while the left is aligning. Similar appearance is expected for millimetre-scale motion.
what_the_screenshot_shows.limits: Camera changes cannot convert this prevention test into a recovery or full cable-assembly result.

verified_achievements: Pinned native Windows AIC/MuJoCo integration with real UR5e/SC collision assets, explicit source/asset provenance and bounded workers.
Six deterministic free-cable development cases: guided held seating 6/6, continuation 3/6 with three contact-stall deadlines; zero guided retries/witnessed recoveries.
Isolated rigid SC retention result: all seat first; zero net pull persists; 0.5/2 N unseat in about 12/6 ms at both tested resolutions. This is not a manufacturer retention measurement.
Original cycle: 37 physical trials, 1,185,841 native steps, 595.203 s summed launcher wall; no learned cable training. 375 CPU tests passed at the prior source release.
Recorded-state video verified separately; no new integration or new performance evidence from rendering.

ranked_findings.finding: The experiment never instantiated the proposed cable constraint/recovery problem.
ranked_findings.implication: Do not spend on a predictor until actual clip/post interactions and recoverable residual failures are observed.

ranked_findings.finding: The 6/6 versus 3/6 comparison changes alignment, approach and force handling against a weak comparator.
ranked_findings.implication: It demonstrates a useful scripted alignment baseline, not force compensation causality, learned advantage, reliability generalization or recovery.

ranked_findings.finding: The passive-latch failure was used as an overbroad universal stop.
ranked_findings.implication: Keep the failed released-connection gate; register held clip-preserving seating separately and progress on the actual recovery mechanism.

ranked_findings.finding: Anchor/post loads and clip/grasp/mutation values are placeholders in the free-cable worker.
ranked_findings.implication: The current evaluator is not a drop-in constrained-cable benchmark. Implement real geometry/sensing and lifecycle guard controls.

ranked_findings.finding: Robot dt refinement also changes low-level servo cadence; native and post-forward force streams are mixed for aborts.
ranked_findings.implication: Freeze independent clocks and coherent measurement/abort semantics before interpreting numerical sensitivity or running a comparison.

ranked_findings.finding: Compiled cable mass is 53.333 g, not nominal 50 g; root rotates freely; material/contact and spatial behavior lack relevant calibration.
ranked_findings.implication: Conserve compiled physical properties during refinement and validate the mechanics that determine clip escape/repair ranking. Do not claim boot torque or real material calibration.

ranked_findings.finding: Seeds label six deterministic configurations; sparse pose logs do not independently replay every native predicate.
ranked_findings.implication: Use actual split/RNG manifests, native endpoint logs, paired all-request denominators and cluster-aware uncertainty.

ranked_findings.finding: Joint prediction is not yet a defined, isolated mechanism; a factorial interaction can also be explained by a factored model or planner.
ranked_findings.implication: Start with a small outcome ranker only if needed, and compare against separate predictors/full-state rules and a direct history-based selector under matched data/actions.

ranked_findings.finding: Current CPU throughput is not evidence of large-batch GPU training capacity.
ranked_findings.implication: Profile corrected task, reduce redundant runtime work only after parity, and favour a common macro-action dataset before a large on-policy campaign.

ranked_findings.finding: The video is accurately labelled but shows tiny motion with visually merged parts and no research failure mechanism.
ranked_findings.implication: Use a labelled overview and a real common-case failure/repair sequence once built; current polish alone is not a research deliverable.

why_the_goal_is_useful: An insertion repair can unload or realign the connector while tensioning another cable span or pulling an earlier clip free. A supervisor that chooses the right repair without undoing earlier work could reduce interrupted jobs. This is an industrial motivation, not an achieved result.

contribution_contract.engineering_floor: Reproducible constrained-cable task, credible load/contact/clip controls, a strong practical controller and honest complete-request accounting. A simulator import or missing latch alone is not a robot-learning contribution.
contribution_contract.empirical_research_target: Establish when observed cable constraints change useful repair choices and whether learned consequences improve held clip-preserving completion on held-out layouts/mechanics beyond competent rules/planning at matched acquisition and inference costs.
contribution_contract.mechanistic_requirement: Show both held-out consequence/ranking validity and improved closed-loop decisions; remove the proposed mechanism while retaining comparable inputs, data, action library, capacity and selector. Separate/local predictors must remain credible.
contribution_contract.negative_result: A strong rule/planner solving the registered feasible support is useful engineering evidence and defeats the need for this candidate on that support. A learning failure or numerical artifact without an identified boundary is not automatically a publishable result.
contribution_contract.novelty: Unsupported at present. Staritz covers cable-load bias, Wilson tactile cable assembly/retries, Luo learned corrective skill selection, and Kienle predictive connector optimization. No source absence is inferred from inaccessible papers.
contribution_contract.hardware: No pickup, sensing from cameras, latch strength, electrical/optical function, factory autonomy or simulation-to-hardware transfer has been established.

supersession.legacy_research_checks: Older review/source hashes refer to their recorded source versions; no old verification is silently relabelled as checking this audit revision.

next_action: Implement the new clip/post/strain-relief task and coherent instrumentation, then execute a bounded common-failure and feasible-repair witness block. Do not start with building a passive SC latch or training a speculative network.

scope_and_limitations: Audit conclusions are source/evidence review and prospective study design, not new recovery measurements.
No guaranteed positive result, algorithmic novelty, publication or hiring outcome.
New task geometry, physics margins, dataset and training budget must be measured/frozen before their comparisons; the plan is not a completed study.

owner_steering_and_execution_scope.instruction: Be ambitious with next-session work; do not be conservative.
owner_steering_and_execution_scope.effect: The authoritative study/handover requests a full implementation-through-learning/evaluation campaign with a 12-hour planning window, 90-minute verification reserve, substantial acquisition and at least three independent starts when gates and measured capacity support them. Small 32/16-case blocks are starter tranches, not stopping limits.
owner_steering_and_execution_scope.precedence: This replaces conservative execution caps suggested in independent reviews; their factual findings, physical validity requirements and source evidence remain unchanged.
owner_steering_and_execution_scope.limits: No promised positive result, manufactured difficulty, unverified backend or learning under an invalid task.
